name: air_isentropic_compression_cp
title: Isentropic compression of air: constant cp versus property functions (exercise)
summary: Closed-system isentropic compression of air from 100 kPa and 17 °C to 800 kPa. The model computes the exit temperature and the specific work with constant specific heats, and again from the air property functions at variable heat capacity. Teaching exercise Cengel 7-75.

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of 07-75.EES, compare_solution.py (no --ees-units) reports: 13 common variables, 7 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 1. Maximum relative difference 3.78e-01 on u_1. w prints 1.92e-04; w_bis prints 2.52e-03. All 13 equations are satisfied.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in 07-75.EES (13 variables, EES X9.920), compared with compare_solution.py
verification.notes: compare_solution.py without --ees-units. 13 common variables, 7 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 1 (R#, the built-in in r = R#/molarmass(Air)). Maximum over all common variables is 3.78e-01 on u_1 (unrounded 0.377868). Absolute internal energies are offset and the offset is not constant: u_1 is +125881.46 J/kg and u_2 is +125453.87 J/kg (about +126 kJ/kg). s_1 prints 3.20e-01 (3856.91 versus 5671.84 J/kg-K). w_bis prints 2.52e-03 (169134.19 versus 169561.78 J/kg); the −427.59 J/kg remainder is the difference of the two internal-energy offsets. The constant-cp work w prints 1.92e-04 (168974.36 versus 168941.99 J/kg). Also above rtol: c_p 1.79e-03 (1006.055 versus 1004.254 J/kg-K at 17 °C), c_v 2.48e-03, T_2 2.13e-03 (252.011 versus 252.550 °C). Under rtol: k 6.90e-04, r 6.45e-05, and p_1, p_2, T_1 exact. All 13 equations are satisfied (max relative residual 1.23e-16). 2 iterations with .initials, 3 without. The converted window is square (13 equations, 13 variables), so t_1 and T_1 were left as two spellings and no stored unknown was added. u_1 passes P=p_1. There is no variant. The only property warning is the moist-air hint on Air; the fluid stays Air. No Fahrenheit hint was printed; T_1 stays 17.
